remote.tls.hint: When opening the link on your phone for the first time, the browser will show a self-signed certificate warning. Compare this fingerprint with the browser's certificate details or the QR link (#fp=...) before proceeding.
remote.tls.web.fpMismatch: Warning: URL fingerprint does not match the current server certificate!
remote.tls.web.whyTitle: Why does the browser warn once, and how do I verify the fingerprint?
remote.tls.web.whyBody: Golan uses a locally generated self-signed TLS certificate (ECDSA P-256) to encrypt your control token and all requests over the local network without relying on any external server. Because this certificate is generated locally on your PC rather than issued by a public certificate authority, your phone's browser shows a one-time warning on first connection. To verify the connection: compare the SHA-256 fingerprint shown in your browser's certificate details or QR link (#fp=...) with the fingerprint displayed in Golan's Remote Control window on your PC, then proceed.
